title: Verify that a name/designation mismatch between the portrait caption and signature block is visibly detectable if content is authored inconsistently
description: Record deliberately authored with two different GM Name/Designation values in the two fields (mirroring the discrepancy found in the verified Figma reference). Verifies the system does not silently mask a data-consistency violation of its own acceptance rule.

steps.action: Author the portrait GM Name/Designation and the signature GM Name/Designation with two different values and Publish
steps.expected: Publish succeeds (system does not currently enforce cross-field consistency); visitor page displays both mismatched values as entered, exposing the inconsistency for content-review catch, not a runtime block

title: Verify that the Chamber Legal Framework section renders its configured heading and intro content
description: Intro Section Heading (EN) is 'Chamber Legal Framework' with the configured intro body beneath it. Per the QA Manager (2026-08-12) the English intro is a **single paragraph** whose visual gaps are spacing, not separate paragraphs. Verifies the heading renders in the maroon brand colour above the full intro body, rendered once.

steps.action: In Liferay CMS, set Intro Section Heading (EN) to 'Chamber Legal Framework' and Intro Content (EN) to the configured intro body, then publish
steps.expected: Content saved and published with the success toast shown

steps.action: Open the Chamber's Law page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the intro block visible

steps.action: Inspect the intro heading and the body beneath it
steps.expected: The heading reads 'Chamber Legal Framework' in the maroon brand colour, larger and bolder than body text, with the intro body rendered beneath it in body grey

steps.action: Compare the rendered body text against the authored source
steps.expected: The body matches the authored source exactly - the full text renders once with its internal spacing preserved, and no sentence or block is repeated on the page

title: Verify that the Official Legal References section renders its configured heading above the law entry cards
description: Legal References Section Heading (EN) is 'Official Legal References' with two active published law entries. Verifies the heading renders in the maroon brand colour above the card list.

steps.action: In Liferay CMS, set Legal References Section Heading (EN) to 'Official Legal References' with two active published law entries, then publish
steps.expected: Content saved and published with the success toast shown

steps.action: Open the Chamber's Law page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the section visible below the intro block

steps.action: Inspect the section heading and the card list beneath it
steps.expected: The heading reads 'Official Legal References' in the maroon brand colour, and exactly two law entry cards render beneath it — the heading text is not a repeat of the intro heading
